question.text: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) norms in PMS require:

answer.text: Continuous KYC, transaction monitoring, CTR/STR reporting

explanation.text: The Logic: AML = ongoing process: KYC, periodic re-verification, transaction monitoring, CTR/STR filings to FIU-IND. The Trap: One-time KYC at onboarding insufficient. Cross-Exam Context: XXIV, XXI-B. Manager's Pro-Tip: Use transaction monitoring software with rule-based alerts for CTR/STR candidates.
